newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average gained almost 31 points in late trading to close at 8,062 after earlier sliding more than 65 points.
* The Indonesian rupiah tumbled to 2,646/49 against the dollar at 0145 GMT on Tuesday from an opening of 2,610/20 on falls in the Malaysian ringgit and the Singapore dollar, dealers said.
* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index fell 17.27 points, or 2.56 percent, to close at 658.17 points on worries over higher interest rates and sharp declines in neighbouring markets, brokers said.
* Eterindo, Bank Mashill and Unggul Indah after announcements of first half results.

* Steady Safe as the transportation firm was reported that it might face difficulties in securing permits to go ahead with the proposed operation of luxury inner city trains in Jakarta and surrounding areas.
* Small-sized property firm Bumi Modern on reports that privately-owned Bakrie Capital planned to buy a 58-percent stake in the firm.
